fieldData.description: Delve into bovine treasures - tongues, stomachs, intestines, and tails. Explore the offal kingdom, from Mountain Chain Tripe, Honey Comb Tripe, Omasum, and Abomasum, each revealing a unique gastronomic tale.
fieldData.name: Offal

fieldData.description: Short Plate, characterized by alternating layers of fat and muscle, showcases a coarse but marbled texture. The intramuscular fat acts as marbling, resulting in unparalleled juiciness among beef cuts.
fieldData.name: Short Plate

fieldData.description: Top round, with low intramuscular fat and a high protein-to-fat ratio, offers a lean and subtly flavorful profile. Among hindquarter cuts, it stands out for its tenderness and clean taste.
fieldData.name: Top Round

fieldData.description: Short Rib, renowned for its rich juiciness and intense beefy aroma, complements marbling for a superbly flavorful experience. Its tenderness and chewy texture make it a favorite, especially in skirt steak cuts.
fieldData.name: Short Rib

fieldData.description: Striploin offers a delightful combination of tender beef protein and the savory aroma of intramuscular fat. Comprising a single muscle, it boasts a fine and tender texture.
fieldData.name: Striploin

fieldData.description: Ribloin features finely marbled, tender meat with a deep beefy juiciness and the delightful flavor of marbling. It stands out among Wagyu cuts for its rich and savory taste.
fieldData.name: Ribloin

fieldData.description: Known for its high collagen and elastin content, Shank presents a dense concentration of beefy aroma and a subtly rich flavor. Its characteristic chewiness enhances the overall dining experience.
fieldData.name: Shank

fieldData.description: Rump, with its deep color and rich beefy aroma, exhibits a surprisingly tender and flavorful texture. Despite its robust appearance, the meat is tender and juicy.
fieldData.name: Rump

fieldData.description: Knuckle, featuring the highest protein content and a beefy aroma, boasts thin and tender muscle fibers. Its fine texture and tenderness make it a delightful choice for those seeking a flavorful Wagyu beef experience.
fieldData.name: Knuckle

fieldData.description: Gooseneck round, nearly devoid of fat, boasts intense juiciness and a robust flavor profile. Its lean composition contributes to an excellent chewy texture.
fieldData.name: Gooseneck Round

fieldData.description: Clod is characterized by lower fat content but abundant juiciness, providing a robust beefy aroma. Its excellent chewability makes it an ideal cut to savor the taste of beef protein.
fieldData.name: Clod

fieldData.description: Brisket, with its strong umami from the abundant marbling and thick layer of fat, boasts a rich juiciness and exceptionally savory fat flavor. It offers a unique texture - tender yet satisfyingly chewy.
fieldData.name: Brisket
